title: Scheduler capacity scope: full provider account or enforceably bounded Jarvis domain

conditions.description: Choose the intended capacity guarantee. (A) Full provider-account capacity, including sessions started outside Jarvis: preserve HOLD until an authenticated complete provider session enumeration and race fence are demonstrated. (B) Limit the guarantee to a defined Jarvis-controlled admission domain: this needs a shared durable gate across every in-domain send path plus initial reconciliation; it does not count or constrain external sessions. Evidence: Worker 23 checkpoint 13965 and Worker 21 checkpoint 14021 identify generic, scheduled and manual launch paths and establish no current complete provider issuer or common gate. No additional signing, per-dispatch approvals, or live activation is proposed. If A is intended, identify any available existing provider authority or confirm the full-account requirement; if B, define included senders. Both choices retain unknown occupancy and require independent review and separate cutover authorization.
